newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Lend Lease says not a bidder for Axiom.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Lend Lease says not a bidder for Axiom.

text.p: Lend Lease Corp Ltd said on Thursday it was not a bidder for the New South Wales state government's Axiom funds management group.

Axiom, formerly known as State Super, has about A$17 billion of funds under management and manages the state's public sector retirement funds. Lend Lease had been seen by analysts as a potential buyer after the group was put up for sale last year.
But managing director David Higgins told reporters after the release of half-year results that the company was not a bidder.
"We are not a bidder at Axiom, but because there is a bid process underway it is not really appropriate for us to comment on it," Huggins said.
New South Wales Treasurer Michael Egan said last year the sale was expected to be completed in early 1997.
